Musk October 2022 earnings call FSD beta wide release end of year city streets driverless

sources_considered.why: Reuters report on the January 2022 Tesla earnings call, quoting Musk directly.
Report on Musk's Q3 2022 earnings-call statements about FSD.

receipt.public_excerpt: “I would be shocked if we do not achieve full self-driving safer than human this year. I would be shocked,” Musk said

evidence_items.explanation: Within the year before the post, Tesla's CEO publicly said full self-driving on general roads was imminent. That is someone 'pretending' to be close to off-highway autonomy.

receipt.public_excerpt: Musk reiterated during the conference that he still believes Tesla can achieve full self-driving. The FSD software should be able to provide customers with a generally hands-free solution for driving, with very few, if any, interventions from the drivers.

evidence_items.explanation: Three months before the post, Musk was still promoting near-intervention-free FSD on general roads. Part of this sentence is the reporter's paraphrase.

receipt.public_excerpt: the wide rollout of the FSD Beta program does not equal FSD getting out of Beta and becoming the autonomous driving feature that Musk has promised for many years.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows the claims were promises, not achievements. This fits Marcus's wider point but not the 'nobody pretends' wording.

unresolved_gaps: No primary earnings-call transcript was read; Musk's statements come from news reports.
I did not check other developers (Waymo, Cruise) for comparable claims; they ran city robotaxis but did not claim cross-country capability.
